name: Baltussen ROD ES

source.title: Hedging demand and market intraday momentum
source.source_markets: ES, NQ, YM directly represented; portfolio of 60+ futures

mandatory_same_session_close: Exit at 16:00 research-window close; operational order must finish before the close.
max_entry_rule_origin: Selected research specification; one initial entry, no same-day re-entry. This cap is not an observed frequency.
observed_trade_frequency: NOT REPORTED for this exact selected specification

source_rules.indicator: Return r_ROD = price 30 minutes before the defined research close / prior research-window close − 1. Trade sign for the final half hour.
source_rules.buy: At 15:30 of the paper session, enter long if r_ROD > 0.
source_rules.sell_short: At 15:30 of the paper session, enter short if r_ROD <= 0.
source_rules.exit: Exit at 16:00 research-window close; operational order must finish before the close.
source_rules.position_sizing: Source uses equal-weighted 1/N portfolio; single-contract sizing is an untested implementation assumption.
source_rules.cost_treatment: Paper's Table 6 is gross; authors say ES remains positive net Sharpe under a one-tick cost assumption, not a full retail fee/slippage audit.

source_reported_performance: Equity-futures 1/N portfolio: gross annual return 6.86%, Sharpe 1.73; ES individual ROD predictive OOS R² 2.29%, not an ES trading P&L.
source_sample: ES history in paper 1982-04-23–2020-05-01, with early standard contract extension; modern ES-only sample is shorter.
known_risks: Closing-window liquidity, auction/settlement price mismatch, cost erosion, high-volatility reversals.
data_requirements: Minute or quote data for the exact dated CME/CBOT contract, prior 16:00 research-window close, current 15:30 quote, and exit quote.
proposed_adaptations_not_source_validate: Use exact dated contract, a volume-based roll chosen using the prior day, one position maximum, finish execution before the defined close, and test a stop separately. No CFD or micro-futures transfer is established.

research_score.meaning: Research priority judgment; not probability of profitability

evidence_status: Peer-reviewed forecast OOS; ES one-tick sensitivity
